name: Ca na Joaneta
notes: Sheet 0 (Different Desing, Pla de Mallorca between Ariany and Maria de la Salut, a 5,500 m2 plot): the reconstruction of an isolated century-old stone farmhouse on its original walls, using only the old stones and local materials: honey-coloured rubble stone laid dry-looking, a pitched clay-tile roof, small openings with mustard-yellow timber shutters and a stone well-head or block at the door, a gravel court, dry-stone boundary walls with a stone-circle at the front, red earth, Aleppo pines hiding it from the road. The gable end of the two-storey volume (photograph 3) has a low stone annexe with a terrace beside it; inside, white walls, an open living space, a timber stair and a pine-beamed mezzanine bedroom with a rooflight (photographs 1 and 6; not modelled). Modelled: the two-storey house with its gable roof, the lower wing, the shuttered openings, terrace, walls, pines. Guessed: the footprint (11 x 6.5 m for the main volume), the wing, the plot's extent. A private home placed at its town only (the article lists Palma; the place is in the Pla de Mallorca - nothing more exact than the island's town is given).
